jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Internship
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for passionate and motivated **Full Stack Developer Interns** to join our team. This internship is designed to provide hands\-on industry experience by working on live web development projects under the guidance of experienced developers.

If you're eager to learn modern web technologies and build real\-world applications, this internship is the perfect opportunity to kickstart your software development career.

What You'll Learn

* Frontend Development using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React.js
* Backend Development using Node.js, PHP, and Python
* Database Management with MySQL and MongoDB
* REST API Development and Integration
* Git \& GitHub Version Control
* Responsive Web Development
* Real Client Project Development
* Software Development Best Practices

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain responsive web applications
* Assist in frontend and backend development
* Build and integrate APIs
* Design and manage databases
* Test, debug, and optimize applications
* Collaborate with designers and developers on live projects
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code
* Follow coding standards and development best practices

Requirements

* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Understanding of web development fundamentals
* Basic knowledge of any programming language (PHP, Python, JavaScript, etc.) is an advantage
* Familiarity with MySQL or MongoDB is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Willingness to learn and work in a team environment
* Freshers, final\-year students, and recent graduates are welcome to apply

Internship Benefits

* 7\-Month Professional Training \& Internship
* Work on Live Client Projects
* Hands\-on Practical Learning
* Internship \& Experience Certificate upon successful completion
* 100% Technical Support \& Mentorship
* Build a Strong Professional Portfolio
* Exposure to Real Industry Workflows
* Full\-Time, In\-Office Internship
* Opportunity for Full\-Time Employment based on performance
* Career Guidance and Job Support after successful completion

**Work Schedule:** Monday to Saturday (Full\-Time)

**Work Location:** In\-person, Nashik, Maharashtra

Pay: ₹3,160\.91 \- ₹4,746\.70 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Web Developer \- Fresher

**Location:** Greater Noida

**Company Overview:**  
Debox Technology is an innovative and dynamic organization focused on delivering top\-quality digital solutions to clients. We are looking for a talented and motivated fresher to join our team as a Web Developer. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience, work on exciting projects, and develop your skills in a supportive environment.

**Job Description:**  
As a Web Developer, you will work alongside experienced developers to design, develop, and maintain websites and web applications. You will play a key role in creating user\-friendly, responsive, and visually appealing websites that meet the needs of our clients and enhance the user experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist in building and maintaining websites and web applications
* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code
* Troubleshoot and debug issues as they arise
* Work collaboratively with designers, content creators, and other team members
* Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs
* Optimize websites for speed and scalability
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest industry trends and technologies

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or relevant coursework)
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Familiarity with front\-end frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap, jQuery) is a plus
* Knowledge of backend technologies (e.g., Node.js, PHP) is an advantage
* Exposure to database systems like MySQL or MongoDB is beneficial
* Problem\-solving skills and an eye for detail
* Ability to work independently and in a team setting
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies

**Benefits:**

* Mentorship and training from experienced developers
* Exposure to real\-world projects and clients
* Opportunity to grow within the company
* Flexible work environment (mention if remote options are available)
* Competitive salary and benefits package

**How to Apply:**

Interested candidates should send their resume and a brief cover letter to hr@deboxtechnology.com.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher, Internship

Pay: From ₹5,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
